sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: 24 pieces; every four make a heart. Tags give the items you need.

items.name: Lumpy Pumpkin chandelier
items.howTo: Go upstairs in the Lumpy Pumpkin and roll into the balcony railing twice in quick succession. The chandelier crashes down; pick up the piece and the Rupees from the ground floor.
items.after: Goddess Sword (when you can first fly around the Sky)
items.notes: Pumm then makes you work off the damage. Finishing his chores gives a second piece (Pumm's chores).

items.name: Great Tree tightrope platform
items.howTo: Where a natural land bridge makes an "m" shape with a ramp in the middle, climb up and head left towards the Great Tree. Cross the tightrope to the platform sticking out of the tree.
items.notes: HD: with button controls, keep your balance with the left stick instead of tilting the Wii Remote.

items.name: Goddess Chest by the Faron pillar
items.area: Small island closest to the Faron pillar of light, near Pumpkin Landing
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube just outside the Skyview Temple entrance in the Deep Woods, then fly to the small island beside the Faron pillar of light and open the chest.
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is the second one in the Deep Woods, by the Skyview Temple entrance.

items.name: Behind bars in Skyview Temple
items.area: Skyview Temple, room with the giant bird statue
items.howTo: In the round room where you found the Beetle, go behind the bird statue: the piece is behind bars. Fly the Beetle up to the statue's neck and hit the crystal switch in the alcove, which is open on the north side, to lift the bars.
items.notes: You can come back for it after the dungeon.

items.name: Batreaux: 10 Gratitude Crystals
items.howTo: Show Batreaux 10 Gratitude Crystals: Wryna's 5 from finding Kukiel plus five loose crystals found at night are enough. Crystals aren't used up.
items.after: Finding Kukiel (after placing the Ruby Tablet)
items.notes: Batreaux's second reward for Gratitude Crystals, a side quest. Zelda's Palace and one Zelda Wiki table say 15 crystals; the game's data, Zelda Dungeon and StrategyWiki say 10.

items.name: Ledge near the bone bridge
items.area: Above the lava, by the skeletal bridge
items.howTo: When you reach the skeletal bridge over the lava, don't cross. Climb the rocks to the right and follow the upper ledges round to the east and south. The piece is on a lower ledge just past an enemy with a shell.

items.name: Behind a bombable rock in Faron Woods
items.area: Start of Faron Woods, among the big mushrooms
items.howTo: Go back to the start of Faron Woods, near the Sealed Grounds, where the big mushrooms are. Bomb the rocks on the right of the path to open a small cave with the piece.

items.name: Secret passageway chest
items.howTo: In the north-east of the desert, follow the raised road to the end of the narrow passage, drop down and bomb the cracked wall at its entrance. The chest with the piece is at the end of the passage.

items.name: Goddess Chest on Beedle's Island
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube by the mine-cart ride at the Temple of Time, then land on top of Beedle's Island, east of Bamboo Island, and open the chest above Beedle's hut.
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is hit from the mine cart at the north-west of the Temple of Time.

items.name: Pumm's chores
items.howTo: After breaking the chandelier, do Pumm's three jobs: take a Bottle of Hot Pumpkin Soup to Eagus in the Sparring Hall before it cools, carry Kina's stack of pumpkins to the shed without dropping one, then at night play the Goddess's Harp in time with the swaying customers while Kina sings. Pumm then gives you the piece.
items.notes: Side quest: Pumm's chandelier debt. Zelda's Palace says the pumpkin job opens after the Earth Temple. HD: with button controls, balance the pumpkins with the left stick and strum the harp with the right stick.

items.name: Dodoh's High Dive
items.howTo: Pay Dodoh 20 Rupees and get shot up from the cannon. Fall through the rings while dodging the Dodoh balls to build up the ×10 multiplier, then land on the 50-Rupee space of the spinning wheel: 500 Rupees and, the first time, the piece.
items.after: Dodoh's Party Wheel (Gratitude Crystal side quest)
items.notes: Minigame. Tip from Zelda Dungeon: the wheel turns about two-thirds of a turn between the last ring and your landing. HD: with button controls, steer your fall with the left stick.

items.name: Goddess Chest in the locked shed
items.area: Shed reached by an underwater passage
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube by the Eldin Volcano sand slide. Then dive into Skyloft's river and swim through the underwater passage at the base of the windmill to the pond inside the shed.
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is below the big sand slide in Eldin Volcano.

items.name: Goddess Chest inside the volcanic island
items.area: Crater-shaped island east of the Lanayru pillar of light
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube below the south-east side of Faron's Great Tree. Then fly to the crater-shaped island east of the Lanayru pillar: the chest is on a high ledge inside the crater. Skydive straight onto the ledge, or clawshot up to it.
items.after: Water Dragon's Scale (top of the Great Tree)
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is on a ledge below the south-east of the Great Tree. The Clawshots make the chest easier.

items.name: Zelda's wardrobe
items.howTo: Climb onto the Knight Academy roof, clawshot to the target on the bath chimney, drop in and crawl through to Zelda's room. Open the wardrobe.

items.name: Sandship stern chest
items.howTo: Climb the main mast and ride the pulleys all the way to the stern. Clawshot the target on the beam at the back of the ship and drop down to the chest on the ledge you saw on the map.
items.notes: Zelda's Palace gets it after the Bow.

items.name: Goddess Chest atop the waterfall
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube above the door of the Pirate Stronghold. In Skyloft, clawshot to the vines on the floating rock outside the Waterfall Cave, then on up to the top of the waterfall island.
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is above the Pirate Stronghold door, reached by Clawshot targets.

items.name: Rickety Coaster: Heart Stopping! track
items.howTo: Pay Gortram 20 Rupees and choose the Heart Stopping! track. Lean into the curves without flying off and finish in under 1:05 for the piece (first time only).
items.notes: Minigame. Zelda Dungeon's heart list says after the Sandship; its minigame page and Zelda Wiki say after the Shipyard's Moldarach. HD: with button controls, lean with the left stick.

items.name: Fledge's Pumpkin Pull
items.howTo: Once Fledge has finished his training, pay him 20 Rupees and shoot the pumpkins he throws with the Bow. Hits in a row are worth 10, 20, 30, 40, then 50 points, and sparkling pumpkins double. Score 600 within 90 seconds for the piece.
items.notes: Minigame, sometimes called Pumpkin Archery. It opens after Fledge's Gratitude Crystal side quest. HD: with button controls, aim the Bow with the right stick.

items.name: Mogma in the Fire Sanctuary
items.howTo: In the far north-west of the Fire Sanctuary, dig into the soft soil with the Mogma Mitts. Corner the Mogma underground and he hands over the piece.

items.name: Dig spot on the way to the Fire Sanctuary
items.area: Where the second wall of fire was
items.howTo: On the path to the Fire Sanctuary, where the second wall of fire blocked the way (the frog statue you watered), dig the spots on the right with the Mogma Mitts. One leads underground to the piece.

items.name: Goddess Chest on Bug Rock
items.howTo: Strike the Goddess Cube in the Volcano Summit waterfall area. On Bug Rock, stand on the castle-like overhang above the water at the top and drop to the wooden ledge below on the south-west side. Clawshot the vines to leave.
items.notes: Goddess Chest: its cube is on a ledge you glide to from the Volcano Summit waterfall.

items.name: Gorko's Goddess Wall riddle
items.howTo: Near the Behind the Temple Bird Statue, play the Goddess's Harp by the Blessed Butterflies to reveal a Goddess Wall. Talk to Gorko, charge a Skyward Strike and draw the shape his riddle describes in one stroke. The first right answer earns the piece.
items.after: The Imprisoned (first fight), with the Goddess's Harp
items.notes: Side quest: Gorko's Goddess Wall. If Gorko isn't there, come back later in the story; Zelda's Palace has it after the Fire Sanctuary.

items.name: Beedle's Airshop
items.area: Beedle's Airshop, flying over Skyloft by day
items.howTo: Buy it for 1,600 Rupees. Beedle stocks it only after you've bought the Life Medal (800 Rupees), and you need a wallet that holds 1,600. Return his beetle first and it costs 800.
items.notes: Guides differ on what unlocks it: after the Life Medal (Zelda's Palace, Gamer Guides), after the Big Wallet (Zelda's Palace) or after the other health items.

items.name: Thunder Dragon's Lightning Round: 4 wins
items.howTo: Talk to the Thunder Dragon and take on the boss battles. Win four in a row, then stop: only the last battle's prize is given, so quit after the fourth for the piece (first time only).
items.after: Giving the Thunder Dragon the Life Tree Fruit
items.notes: Minigame. You can't use pouch items such as potions inside, only the shield you have equipped.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each of the six dungeon bosses. You start with 6 hearts; the most is 18.

items.name: Ghirahim (Skyview Temple)
items.howTo: Defeat Ghirahim, the boss of the Skyview Temple, and pick up the Heart Container.

items.name: Scaldera (Earth Temple)
items.howTo: Defeat Scaldera, the boss of the Earth Temple, and pick up the Heart Container.

items.name: Moldarach (Lanayru Mining Facility)
items.howTo: Defeat Moldarach, the boss of the Lanayru Mining Facility, and pick up the Heart Container.

items.name: Koloktos (Ancient Cistern)
items.howTo: Defeat Koloktos, the boss of the Ancient Cistern, and pick up the Heart Container.

items.name: Tentalus (Sandship)
items.howTo: Defeat Tentalus, the boss of the Sandship, and pick up the Heart Container.

items.name: Ghirahim (Fire Sanctuary)
items.howTo: Defeat Ghirahim, the boss of the Fire Sanctuary, and pick up the Heart Container.
